Dr Leonid Sternik has many years of experience in coronary artery bypass grafting, both on and off the heart-lung machine, and in other methods of repairing and replacing the aorta. His expertise also covers the repair and replacement of the aortic, mitral and tricuspid valves. Among the modern methods he uses are the successful treatment of atrial fibrillation by the MAZE procedure, cardiac myectomy, and the removal of various heart tumours, including myxoma, and of growths in the chest.

Dr Sternik's success rate is among the highest in Israel. That record rests on his excellent command of modern methods of minimally invasive cardiac surgery, which he acquired during fellowships at leading Israeli medical centres and at the Mayo Clinic in the United States. Thanks to his extensive experience and deep knowledge, he has successfully treated thousands of patients from countries around the world.

Alongside his extensive clinical practice, Dr Sternik heads the department for the treatment of atrial fibrillation, which he founded together with Professor Raanani. That department is today one of Europe's leading centres for the treatment of arrhythmia. Hundreds of doctors from Europe come to Israel each year to develop their skills under Dr Sternik's guidance.

Dr Sternik is also known for his research, as the author of many papers and the head of several research programmes. He is, in addition, a much sought-after lecturer at Tel Aviv University and at several prestigious institutions abroad.

Education and medical practice:

  • Moscow Medical Institute — degree
  • Tel Aviv University — degree from the faculty of medicine
  • Sheba Medical Centre (Tel HaShomer, Israel) — fellowship in cardiothoracic surgery
  • Mayo Clinic, Rochester (USA) — advanced training

Membership of international organisations:

  • Israel Society of Cardiac Surgeons
  • Society of Thoracic Surgeons, USA
  • European Association for Cardio-Thoracic Surgery

Dr Lev Mendelevich is an outstanding cardiologist from Israel whose expertise in cardiology is recognised not only in his own country but beyond it. Holding the post of senior physician in the cardiology department of a medical centre and serving as chief consultant at the prestigious Assuta clinic, Dr Mendelevich has proved himself an expert of the highest class.

With more than 35 years of experience in the study and treatment of heart and vascular disease, Dr Mendelevich has earned a reputation as a specialist with an impeccable command of clinical cardiology, coronary angiography and the treatment of arrhythmia. His ability to diagnose the most complex heart conditions using modern methods such as echocardiography places him among the world's elite cardiologists.

Dr Mendelevich also studies and treats a wide range of conditions, including angina, pericarditis, heart failure, myocardial infarction and coronary artery disease. His professionalism contributes to Israel's standing as one of the world's leading centres in cardiology.

As an active member of the medical community, Dr Mendelevich makes a significant contribution to academic work as the author of many research papers. His standing is confirmed by membership of a number of professional associations and by the prestigious awards he has received in cardiology.

Dr Lev Mendelevich is not only a leading specialist in his field but a doctor whose work saves and changes the lives of thousands of patients.

EDUCATION

  • Pavlov St Petersburg State Medical University, Russia
  • Clinical residency in cardiology, St Petersburg, Russia
  • Residency in general medicine at the Tel Aviv medical centre, Israel
  • Specialisation in cardiology and advanced specialisation in echocardiography at the Tel Aviv medical centre, Israel
  • Fellowships at leading medical centres in Europe and the United States

LANGUAGES

  • Russian
  • English
  • Hebrew

Dr Marina Anuk is a highly qualified Israeli rheumatologist specialising in the treatment of a wide range of rheumatological conditions. She takes a particular professional interest in developing new, modern methods of restoring joints affected by degenerative change. Dr Anuk successfully treats vasculitis, scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), with strong results in this field.

Education

  • Faculty of medicine, university in Tbilisi, Georgia.
  • Fellowship in internal medicine at the Ichilov medical centre, Israel.
  • Specialisation in rheumatology at the Ichilov medical centre, Israel.

Languages

  • Russian
  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations

  • Israel Medical Association.
  • Israel Society of Internal Medicine.
  • Israel Society of Rheumatology.

Dr Mark Gotkine
Specialisation: neurology, treatment of neuromuscular disease

Main areas of specialisation:

Dr Mark Gotkine is a leading neurologist and specialist in the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) in Israel. He heads the multidisciplinary ALS clinic at the Hadassah medical centre and has more than 16 years of professional experience. In 2019 he was included in the ranking of Israel's best doctors published by Forbes.

  • Clinical neurology
  • Treatment of neuromuscular disease
  • Treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS)
  • Disorders of the musculoskeletal system

Professional path:

Dr Gotkine is Israel's leading expert in the diagnosis and treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In 2008 he founded the multidisciplinary ALS clinic at the Hadassah medical centre and has headed it ever since. Under his leadership the clinic has become an international centre visited by patients not only from Israel but from countries around the world. For his achievements in the treatment of ALS, Dr Gotkine received a special award from the Israeli Ministry of Health.

Education, training and advanced courses:

  • 1993-1999: Graduated with distinction from the faculty of medicine at King's College London, taking the degrees of Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS).
  • 1995-1996: Alongside his medical studies, took a first degree in neuroscience, graduating with distinction.
  • Fellowship: Neurology department, Robert Jones and Agnes Hunt Orthopaedic Hospital (Oswestry, Shropshire, United Kingdom).
  • Residency: Neurology at the Hadassah university clinic (Jerusalem, Israel).

Academic and research work:

Dr Gotkine is actively engaged in research and is the author of more than 40 papers published in prestigious international journals in medicine and biology. In 2015 he received the prestigious Prusiner-Abramsky Research Award for his work on the genetic analysis of inherited ALS.

Clinical trials of innovative treatments for ALS are frequently conducted at the Hadassah clinic under Dr Gotkine's direction and supervision, which allows patients to receive the newest therapies.

Membership of medical associations:

Dr Gotkine takes an active part in international symposia and conferences and contributes to the development of effective approaches to treating neurological disease, which makes him a sought-after consultant and an excellent diagnostician, able to identify quickly any disorder of the peripheral nervous system or any neuromuscular or musculoskeletal condition.

Dr Mark Gotkine is one of the best-known researchers in the field of neuromuscular disease, and his work is widely recognised in the medical community.

Professor Michael Shechter is an outstanding Israeli cardiologist specialising in non-invasive and invasive cardiology. His name is widely known in the international medical community: in 2005 he was named the best cardiologist in Europe, and he is an international expert in the study of the function of the coronary endothelium.

Experience and specialisation:

  • More than 25 years of professional experience.
  • Cardiology, cardiac surgery.

Education and professional path:

  • 1980: Graduated from the faculty of medicine, Tel Aviv University.
  • From 1991: Specialist in cardiology, cardiology department of the Chaim Sheba Medical Centre.
  • 1991-2000: Consultant cardiologist to Magen David Adom, Israel's emergency medical service.
  • 1992: Completed a master's degree in cardiology, faculty of medicine, Tel Aviv University.
  • 1995-1998: Fellowship in cardiac rehabilitation, the treatment of raised blood lipids, and endothelial and platelet function at the Cedars-Sinai medical centre, Los Angeles, USA.

Awards:

  • 2003: Annual prize of the American College of Nutrition for research into nutrition for patients with heart disease.
  • 2005: Named best cardiologist in Europe.
  • 2010: Research on blood lipids recognised as the best scientific paper in the United States.

Academic experience:

  • Teacher at the medical institute of Tel Aviv University.

Membership of professional organisations:

  • Israel Heart Society.
  • European Society of Cardiology.
  • American Heart Association.
  • Israel society of aviation and space medicine.

Professor Michael Vaiman, an internationally recognised expert in otolaryngology, carries out the full range of surgical procedures on the head and neck, covering both cancer surgery and plastic procedures.

Education and specialisation:

  • Medical degree in the USSR, further qualification in otolaryngology at the Ichilov hospital in Israel.
  • Considered one of Israel's best specialists in the treatment of epilepsy.
  • A leading ENT surgeon, he performs head and neck operations, including cancer and plastic surgery.

Operations on:

  • The larynx and pharynx.
  • The sinuses.
  • Rhinoplasty.
  • The thyroid gland.
  • Endoscopic operations on the salivary glands.

Treatment of epilepsy:

  • Uses the method of vagus nerve stimulation.

Experience and professional activity:

  • More than 15,000 surgical procedures performed.
  • Holds private consultations at his own clinic and consults at various Israeli clinics, Assuta among them.
  • Held the post of leading surgeon in the department of otolaryngology and head and neck surgery at the Assaf Harofeh medical centre.

Research and achievements:

  • Studies problems in the treatment of the ENT organs in depth and carries out research in this field.
  • Has received many prizes from medical societies for his contribution to medicine and for new surgical techniques.
  • Named «International Scientist of the Year 2002» by Cambridge University.
  • Author of distinctive techniques that produce excellent results in operations on the nose and the paranasal sinuses.
  • Professor at Tel Aviv University.

Membership of organisations:

  • Member of the Israel Association of Otolaryngology.
  • Member of the European association of otolaryngology.
  • Member of the American Academy of Otolaryngology.
